title: Enrollment Specialist - Bilingual Spanish (Health Outreach)
description:
Our Company:

At Isaac Health , we're on a mission to improve brain health at the population level by providing greater access to specialty brain health and dementia care services for all. We believe that everyone everywhere deserves to get the care they need, and are striving to make care convenient and accessible while tackling the stigmas that surround brain health conditions.

Since launching in 2022, Isaac Health has scaled to provide brain health and dementia care services to more patients and families across the US. With support from leading healthcare investors, and impactful leaders like you, we’ll continue to provide high-quality patient-centered care for the evaluation and management of brain health conditions and deliver exceptional client and family outcomes for years to come. With a heavy focus on clinical quality and safety in all that we do, we’ve accomplished excellent outcomes for our clients:

• 92% of patients report an improvement against their cognitive goals in only 3 weeks after working with Isaac Health .

• 73% of patients or their care partners continue to report improvement in neurocognitive symptoms after 6 months

• 70% of patients remain engaged with Isaac Health after 6 months

This is just the beginning for Isaac Health , and we won’t stop building, growing, and iterating until everyone, everywhere can access high-quality, evidence-based brain health and dementia care without high costs or long wait times. We’re looking for mission-driven leaders who share these values, and we need your help as we transform access to high-quality brain health care in the United States and beyond.

To learn more about our company, visit

In this mission-critical role, you will be the first point of contact-an essential guide who blends a supportive, patient-first approach with a proactive engagement mindset. Leveraging your organizational expertise, you will orchestrate seamless care journeys, coordinating critical sessions between patients, their caregivers, our expert medical team, and external care team members.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective interaction with patients, the medical team and internal team members.

• Fluent in Spanish

• High levels of professionalism in communication, high level of patience and caring attitude with patients and family members.

• Demonstrated call center experience, handling high-volume outbound and/or inbound calls.

• Prior telehealth experience is a plus

• Familiarity with Medicare and Insurance concepts

• Proven efficiency in patient documentation, typing skills, ensuring accuracy and completeness

• Experience navigating multiple systems and completing documentation simultaneously during an outbound call

• Strong over-all tech-saviness and ability to quickly learn new software and systems.

• Competency with Google Office Suite

• Experience working with the elderly

• Excellent organizational and management skills, highly organized in approach and keeping track of complex information flows

• A strong ability to quickly pick up and adhere to defined workflows and mandatory scripting requirements.

• Comfort and proficiency working in a remote office setting

• Experience working with the elderly population with patience and empathy

Key Responsibilities:

• Reach out to patients who have expressed an interest in care to explain Isaac Health ’s services and offerings

• Coordinate cognitive health screening campaigns

• Take the medical history from patients or their caregivers

• Schedule and coordinate appointments

• Assist patients with technology and other questions

Competitive Compensation & Premium Benefits

description:
L3 TECHNICAL SUPPORT ENGINEER, ENTERPRISE NETWORKING AND AV SOLUTIONS

Location: Remote, Canada (British Columbia preferred)
Department: Customer Support and Services (CSS)
Reports To: Manager, L3 Technical Support

About the Role

NETGEAR is looking for a highly skilled, customer-focused L3 Technical Support Engineer to join our growing Enterprise Networking and AV technical support team. This is a remote position based in Canada, with a preference for candidates in British Columbia. You'll work hours that line up with Pacific Time to support our North America customers.

You'll be the escalation point for L1 and L2 support. Working with our engineering teams, you'll resolve complex networking and AV-over-IP issues for enterprise customers, MSPs, and integrators. You'll support NETGEAR's switches, WiFi access points, security gateways, and network management solutions, both cloud and on-premises. In this post-sales role, you'll represent NETGEAR to our customers, bringing strong technical skills and excellent customer management to a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Serve as the technical escalation point for Enterprise Networking and AV customers, working with them directly by phone whenever possible

- Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues involving:

- Layer 2 switching and Layer 3 routing

- QoS, IGMP, and STP

- Network and AV-over-IP hardware

- Wireless networking

- AV protocols and interoperability (Dante, NDI, AES67, and others)

- Cloud-based and on-premises management platforms

- Work with engineering and product teams to resolve complex issues and bugs, and share feedback that improves the customer experience

- Replicate issues and validate fixes hands-on in lab environments

- Document solutions, root causes, and workarounds in the knowledge base

- Stay current on emerging networking and AV technologies, including NETGEAR product roadmaps and firmware updates

- Contribute to proactive support work, such as support guides, training for lower-tier support teams, and customer-facing webinars and documentation

What You Bring

- 4+ years of experience in customer-facing technical support, network operations, or field support, ideally in enterprise or AV-over-IP switching environments

- Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to customers at any level of technical expertise

- Extensive knowledge of networking protocols and topologies

- Hands-on expertise with:

- VLANs, QoS, STP/RSTP, and Ethernet switching protocols

- Wireless networking deployment and troubleshooting

- Routing protocols and troubleshooting

- IGMP Snooping, Querier, and multicast traffic optimization

- CLI troubleshooting tools, port mirroring, and packet capture analysis

- Strong working knowledge of Wireshark

- Experience supporting or deploying NETGEAR switches or similar platforms (Cisco, Extreme, Aruba)

- Strong skills with technical documentation, ticketing systems, and remote diagnostic tools

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with ProAV systems and tools such as Dante Controller, Q-SYS, NDI Studio Monitor, AMX, or Crestron NVX

- Experience supporting AV system integrators, event production, or ProAV deployments

- Industry certifications such as NETGEAR Certified, CCNA, CWNA, Dante Level 2+, or AVIXA CTS

- A track record of working remotely and independently

Who You Are

- A confident problem solver who handles escalations calmly and professionally

- Committed to customer satisfaction, with a consultative approach

- A clear, effective communicator with customers, partners, and internal teams

- Detail-oriented, with strong organization and documentation habits

- Collaborative across Support, Engineering, and Product teams

- Flexible with your hours when global customers need support

Company Statement/Values:  

At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect.

Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Join Axon and be a Force for Good

At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

 

Your Impact

As a Principal Technical Program Manager on the Real-Time Operations team, you will own highly complex and ambiguous technical programs that span multiple teams and pillars. You will own the outcome the program exists to deliver and serve as a trusted partner to product, engineering and senior leadership.

You will partner with engineering and product management to drive programs from inception through design, development, deployment and post-production. You will translate early ideas and proposals into executable plans with clear requirements, milestones, dependencies and success metrics.

The ideal candidate builds trusted relationships across a wide range of personalities, holds people to their commitments, and has the technical credibility to be respected by engineers and the executive presence to be heard by senior leaders.

Location: Seattle

Direct reports: None

 

What You'll Do

• Own highly complex technical programs across teams and pillars, from strategy and early definition through launch and post-production.

• Own program plans, schedules, resourcing and change management while holding teams accountable for committed deliverables.

title: Senior Corporate Enterprise Platform Engineer, Windows
description:
Role Description

As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will own and improve Dropbox’s Windows endpoint platform. You will bring deep Windows and Intune expertise, make patching and application delivery more reliable, and build automation that reduces recurring work for the team.

This is a hands-on role combining Windows technical ownership with the development of a more code-managed endpoint platform. You will help evaluate and adopt FleetDM, osquery, infrastructure-as-code, and GitOps practices where they improve reliability, visibility, and maintainability. You will strengthen the current environment while building and validating the path forward-not assume that replacing a tool is the answer.

You will work with CorpInfra, IAM, Security, and support teams to make practical technical decisions, lead multi-phase improvements, and clarify ownership. You will also mentor teammates through pairing, code review, and shared operational practices. This is an individual-contributor role, not a people-management position.

Responsibilities

• Own endpoint reliability and lifecycle management. Improve provisioning, application delivery, updates, security configuration, and troubleshooting across the endpoint environment.

• Make patching predictable and safe. Strengthen update workflows through testing, controlled rollouts, and remediation.

• Make fleet health trustworthy and actionable. Improve reporting on device health, patching, and configuration, with clear ownership for resolving issues.

• Build maintainable automation. Turn recurring work into reliable, tested workflows that other engineers can operate.

• Advance code-managed endpoint operations. Adopt tools and practices that improve configuration management, validation, and deployment.

• Lead cross-functional platform improvements. Define practical roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and balance security, reliability, employee experience, and team capacity.

• Strengthen the team’s capability. Mentor teammates, review code and designs, and document reusable practices that improve coverage across the endpoint team.

Requirements

• Significant experience engineering and operating Windows endpoint environments, with personal ownership beyond ticket handling or routine console administration.

• Deep hands-on Intune experience across device lifecycle, configuration and compliance policies, application management, update workflows, and relevant Entra ID dependencies.

• Strong Windows troubleshooting skills across operating-system behavior, services, logs, networking, certificates, identity, and security controls. Able to distinguish reported management status from actual endpoint health.

• Recent ownership of Windows and third-party application patching, including staged deployment, user-impact validation, failed-device handling, exceptions, and recovery.

• Strong practical PowerShell skills and familiarity with at least one additional programming language, such as Python, Go, or C#. Experience building and maintaining production automation or systems integrations.

• Demonstrated use of version control, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for operational changes. Able to explain safe retries, failure handling, secrets management, and configuration drift.

• Ability to independently define and deliver multi-phase work, prioritize under ambiguity, partner across teams, and mentor other engineers.

• Clear written and verbal communication, including concise technical decisions, incident updates, runbooks, and effective asynchronous collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications

• Production experience with FleetDM on Windows , including agent operations, policies, queries, targeting, API integrations, or configuration managed through GitOps.

• Practical osquery and SQL experience for endpoint inventory, health, or security use cases, including query validation, performance considerations, and handling stale or missing results.

description:
SUMMARY

The Substation Technical Trainer is responsible for the coordination, development, and delivery of classroom and field-based technical training for electrical construction with a focus on substations. This role serves as a subject matter expert for substation curriculum and partners with Operating Group and project leadership to strengthen craft knowledge, safe work practices, and consistent field execution.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and deliver substation-focused electrical training, including instructor-led modules, practical exercises, assessments, and performance evaluations.

• Ensure training materials, tools, equipment, drawings, procedures, and other resources are prepared and available for each training session.

• Coach, mentor, and support project-based instructors, performance evaluators, and proctors to promote consistent delivery and evaluation standards.

• Apply effective presentation methods, adult learning principles, and hands-on instructional techniques to support knowledge transfer and skill development.

• Participate in electrical and substation subject matter reviews with internal stakeholders, NCCER, and other industry organizations, as appropriate.

• Effectively work and build relationships with team members of diverse backgrounds and organizational levels.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Advanced communication, presentation, and classroom and field training facilitation skills

• Knowledge of adult learning theory, instructional methodology, and hands-on skill evaluation

• Working knowledge of substation construction methods, drawings, equipment, systems, and safe work practices

• Basic computer and software skills (Microsoft applications)

• Bilingual English/Spanish fluency preferred

• Ability to connect with and influence craft team members, project leaders, and other stakeholders

• Active listening skills and effective communication, including an openness to diverse input and feedback

• Ability to travel up to 75%

• Journey-level or technician-level electrical knowledge, skills with substation construction, hands-on substation switching experience, commissioning support, or related high-voltage experience (at least five years)

• Electrical Journeyman License (any state)

• Successful completion of NCCER ICTP, or ability to complete after hire

• Knowledge of OSHA requirements, FA/CPR and electrical safety practices applicable to substation construction

• Experience with NCCER electrical curriculum, assessments, and performance profiles preferred

• Classroom and hands-on technical training facilitation experience preferred

• Current driver’s license

title: Knowable AI Content Optimization Specialist II
description:

Do you enjoy partnering across legal, product, engineering, and operations teams to build innovative contract intelligence solutions powered by AI?

Knowable is the world leader in post signature contract management, helping enterprises easily understand the opportunities and commitments in tens or hundreds of thousands of legal contracts. Requirements:

• Experience in legal practice, contract review, contract intelligence, contract management, legal technology, or legal operations.

• Experience deploying LLM-powered workflows into production environments.

• Prior experience with contract analytics or contract intelligence platforms.

• Deep expertise in commercial contract analysis, including vendor agreements, procurement contracts, NDAs, and amendments.

• Ability to assess legal equivalence, materiality, and risk implications across clause variations.

• Experience translating legal judgment into structured systems such as schemas, taxonomies, rubrics, and decision trees.

• Ability to work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations stakeholders.

Work in a way that works for you

description:
Job Title: In-Home Physician Per Diem - La Crosse
Job Location: Work at Home, Wisconsin, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Part time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Per diem employees qualify for:

• Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours
12

description:
The Role : What’s in the Box

We are looking for a talented Category Manager to become part of our European Strategic Sourcing Team. Your role will involve contributing to the development and implementation of category strategies spanning multiple markets across Europe. 

As an International Category Manager, you will collaborate closely with both local and global stakeholders and help ensure we source high-quality ingredients and packaging at the best costs.

This position can be based in Paris or Berlin and we have openings across several categories, including Protein; Produce, Herbs and Fruits; Grocery & Dairy; and Packaging. 

You will be able to tell us which categories interest you most in your application, and we will match you to the best fit.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don't "tick all the boxes" but think you'd thrive in this role, we would like to learn more about you.

What You'll Do : The Recipe

• Shape the category strategy: Help build and roll out category strategies across European markets, aligned with our business objectives and supply chain needs, working hand in hand with senior team members.

• Own supplier relationships and negotiations: Manage key supplier relationships across markets and lead negotiations within your scope to secure the best possible terms, working independently and constructively with internal and external stakeholders.

• Drive savings: Identify and deliver cost reduction opportunities by leveraging volumes and improving processes across markets.

• Build the numbers behind every decision: Develop robust cost models, run make-or-buy analyses and monitor key commodity prices, so we pay fair prices and make well-informed sourcing decisions.

• Stay ahead of the market: Forecast future cost pricing using data, industry knowledge and Generative AI tools, track market trends, regulatory changes and emerging technologies, and challenge the status quo with ideas to improve our processes.

• Lead projects and grow others: Drive short-term procurement projects, support long-term initiatives with cross-functional teams, solve non-routine topics autonomously (aligning regularly with your manager on priorities), and mentor junior team members, interns and working students.

What You'll Bring : 

• Bachelor's or master's degree from a top-tier college or university, preferably in business, engineering, supply chain, finance, or science.

• Minimum of 3 years of strategic procurement or production experience, preferably in the food or food-packaging industry, or alternatively as a management consultant with a focus on operations.

• Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take initiative, work independently, and drive implementation.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to work successfully in flexible team structures around the world.

• Strong organizational and project management skills with a track record of successfully implementing cross-functional projects.

• Capability to excel in flexible global team structures amid a reasonable degree of uncertainty.

• Comfortable contributing to and managing projects, including developing new processes, SLAs, and KPIs.

• Strong at devising creative solutions to supply issues, as well as designing, communicating, and executing action plans for effective resolution.

• Convincing track record of successful negotiations with external partners.

• Strong quantitative and analytical skills.

• Excellent English proficiency is required, another European language is a plus.

• Willingness to travel internationally up to 25% of the time.

What we offer: The Toppings

• The chance to have a serious impact role on one of the most exciting foodtech companies in Europe

• A vibrant & international environment with a great culture & DNA

• A guaranteed steep learning curve

- Basic proficiency in data logging, documentation and data visualization using Excel or Python

- Good communication skills in English

As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

title: Spanish Speaking Oncology Nurse Navigator
description:
CancerNavigator is an early-stage healthcare company (remote, headquartered in Washington, D.C.) dedicated to supporting cancer patients in their hour of need.
Our Mission & Our Work, in Brief
Cancer is the number one cause of death for commercially insured Americans and the top cost driver for health plans. And, cancer patients are struggling.
CancerNavigator is a white-glove, end-to-end, cancer support service for patients and their families. We work with health plans across the country to provide 1-1 support to members facing a cancer diagnosis. All of our support is delivered through dedicated Oncology Certified Nurses, who work with members to catch cancer early, get them to fantastic experts for their care, and help them through the thousands of other problems patients and their families face.
Join us to help serve cancer patients in their hour of need.
The “Nurse Navigator” Role
Our oncology nurse navigators are the front-line of CancerNavigator ’s patient service. Nurse Navigators support patients at all parts of their journey - newly diagnosed, in active treatment, and entering remission. With more specificity, oncology nurse navigators:

• Educate cancer patients (and their families) about their diagnosis, treatment options, and provide helpful information on any related questions and concerns the patient may have

• Work closely with the researchers on our team to deliver tailored information to patients, guiding them to the centers and doctors that would be a great option for the patient’s care

• Do everything possible to address any barriers to care (e.g. registering and scheduling appointments, coordinating with their health plan or their care team, transferring records, etc.)

• Provide longitudinal support to the patient throughout their journey - helping them solve any issues related to their cancer diagnosis and care - whether connecting patients to mental health support, finding resources to ease the financial burden, arranging transportation to appointments, or answering any questions that may arise

The Requirements
The main requirement of this role is oncology nursing experience and a passion for serving cancer patients. More specifically, we are looking for someone with the following experience and qualifications:

• Ability to work Pacific hours (8am-5pm PST)

• Native Spanish Speaker

• 3+ years of oncology nursing experience

• Mastery of common navigation and care coordination issues (registration, scheduling, clinical department navigation, insurance coordination, solving coverage issues, etc.)

• Mastery of basic computer tools (Gmail, Zoom, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)

• Preferred: Oncology Certified Nurse (OCN)

Compensation and Benefits

• Starting Salary Range: $100-115k (based on skills and experience)

• Dental and Healthcare (80% employer paid), Vision Insurance (100% employer paid)

• Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA

• Group Life and AD&D Insurance (involuntary with the option to buy up coverage)

• Unlimited PTO

• Remote-first work; live where you want within the continental US

• All-company on-sites 2x per year (in Washington DC and Denver)

Our Culture & Values, In Brief
We’re building a company where what we do matters. The goal couldn’t be clearer - serve cancer patients. As the business grows, and the work becomes more complex, we need to become more, not less, committed to why we are doing this.
We have three company values, which guide our work:

•
Patients first, always: In everything we do, we put the cancer patient (and their families) first; we exist to serve them in their most urgent moments.

•
Respect for our responsibility: We strive, as a team, to respect the gravity of the responsibility we bear to patients, always acting and producing in a way that is worthy of the trust they have placed in us.

•
Kindness to and respect for others: We treat our teammates well, no exceptions. We are one team.

title: Senior Stack Scientist
description: Senior Stack Scientist About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy. As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance. Key Responsibilities Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks. Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles. Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance. Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams. Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies. Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

title: Manufacturing Engineer, Fury Airframe Launch Team
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Manufacturing team is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to support Fury Manufacturing at Arsenal-1 in Ohio . This is a unique role - You will have the opportunity to first train under our world-class structures manufacturing team at Anduril North Carolina in Morrisville, NC before bringing that standard of excellence back to a permanent installment in Ohio. Frequent travel between our NC and OH sites is to be expected, especially during the initial launch period.

The right person for this role can demonstrate experience in composite and metallic structural assembly in a fast-paced environment, LRIP through FRP. This person will also demonstrate the ability to work across multiple functions (Manufacturing Operations, Design, Quality, Leadership, Supply Chain, etc) to achieve a successful manufacturing approach, flow, and build. This role encompasses everything in a production manufacturing value-chain, including, but not limited to, MBOM management, work instruction creation, design for manufacturability, work cell optimization, tool design & selection, process creation & optimization, vendor sourcing & interaction, quality planning, and work documentation associated with composite and metallic structures.

This role requires relocation to Morrisville, NC for an initial training program (housing, transportation, & related costs provided), and then relocation to Aresnal-1 in Ohio.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Facilitate knowledge and technology transfer between our North Carolina and Ohio manufacturing sites

• Develop process flows, breaking down large, complex assemblies into a logical part flow of subassemblies and sub-processes

• Write manufacturing documentation, such as work instructions, MBOMs, quality plans, inspection requirements, non-conformances, while also completing said work instructions, quality plans, and inspections alongside a team of technicians and inspectors

• Work as a conduit between the engineering technical data packages and the technicians to ensure products are manufactured as designed/analyzed

• Solve manufacturing problems in schedule-driven environment under the constraints of detailed specifications and requirements to achieve the needed quality, while delivering on schedule

• Drive work cell design and optimization to ensure quality and efficiency targets are maintained and managed

• Work with the Program Managers to inform critical decision points to ensure on-time delivery

• Drive RCCAs alongside the quality team to eliminate production blockers and recurring issues

• Help form and track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) in a production environment

• Create detailed simulation models to help inform capacity planning and production line balancing

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in an engineering or technology related field

• 3+ years of experience in a relevant field, preferably manufacturing of airframe structural components and/or assemblies in a production environment

• A genuine interest in manufacturing and thirst for learning

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings including GD&T

• Proficiency in CAD/CAM software (NX preferred)

• Experience with MS Office and/or project management software skills

• Demo

title: Platform Engineer - Security & Compliance
description:
Validio is the agentic data management platform that automates data quality, lineage, and cataloging, so enterprises can finally trust the data behind their analytics, AI, and reporting. As a Platform Engineer focused on Security & Compliance, you own how we prove that trust, and you do it like an engineer, not an administrator.

As we move up-market into banking and regulated industries, a SOC 2 report, an ISO 27001 certificate, and a credible answer to “how do you protect our data” increasingly decide whether a deal closes. This is a hands-on DevSecOps role inside our Platform Engineering team. You’ll own our compliance program end to end, but you’ll run it from a terminal. You’ll turn control requirements into Terraform, CI checks, and custom tests, so controls stay green without anyone chasing screenshots. It’s not a pure cybersecurity or policy role. You’ll write code and work on the platform alongside the rest of the team.

What you’ll do

- Own our compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, and DORA) and run audit cycles from evidence-gathering to the audit room

- Run our Vanta instance and automate it: build custom tests in Go or Python, automate evidence collection, and wire controls into Terraform and GitHub Actions so drift is caught in a PR, not an audit

- Implement the technical measures behind our security policies across GCP, AWS, and Azure, including access management and reviews, logging, secrets, and hardening

- Own security questionnaires and our trust center, and rebuild the answer library so a bank’s 300-question questionnaire takes days, not weeks

- Run vendor security reviews and the data-protection assessments that come with them (DPIAs, LIAs, TRIAs), and keep our risk register honest

- Pitch in on platform and reliability work with the rest of the team

What you’ll bring

- A background in platform, DevOps, cloud, or security engineering. You’ve built and run infrastructure, not just audited it

- Experience owning or heavily supporting a SOC 2 and/or ISO 27001 program, and the ability to turn a control requirement into concrete technical tasks

- Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, ideally GCP (strong AWS or Azure experience also works)

- Production experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD, and enough Go or Python to build the automation this role needs

- Experience with a GRC automation platform such as Vanta, Drata, or Secureframe (Vanta a strong plus), and a firm preference for automating evidence over collecting it by hand

- Clear, persuasive writing: questionnaire answers an enterprise security team trusts, and documentation an auditor accepts the first time

- The drive to get things to closure, including chasing control owners across engineering, IT, HR, and legal

Bonus points for

- ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor, CISA, Security+, CISM, or CISSP

- Supporting compliance for financial-services or other regulated customers

- Vendor-risk (TPRM) experience

Our stack, and why

We use Vanta for compliance automation, because evidence should come from systems, not screenshots. Our infrastructure spans Google Cloud, AWS, and Azure because our customers run on all three, and our workloads run on Kubernetes across GKE, EKS, and AKS. Everything is defined in Terraform and shipped through GitHub Actions, so controls, evidence, and enforcement live in code you can read, query, and test. We write internal tooling and custom tests in Go and Python. Where the automation isn’t there yet, you build it.

Why Validio

Founded in Sweden in 2019, we’re trusted by data-driven enterprises like Nordea, Canva, Truecaller, Traveloka, and Deutsche Glasfaser. We raised a $30M Series A this year and grew ARR 800% in twelve months as enterprises got serious about making their data AI-ready. We’re 35 people today and growing fast across Sweden, London, New York, and Amsterdam. This role is hybrid, and we expect you to work from our Stockholm office at least a couple of days

title: Senior AI Product Manager (Context Engineering)
description:
About the Team/Role:

At WEX, context engineering is the discipline of turning collective company knowledge, operational reality, and business logic into trusted, timely, and permission-aware context for AI agents. As a Senior AI Product Manager (Context Engineering), you will own the enterprise context layer that powers WEX's global fleet of AI agents. In this hands-on builder role within our Data, AI, Risk & Product organization, you will bridge unstructured knowledge, governed semantic data, and agent execution workflows, partnering directly with global engineering, data, and business teams to ensure every AI action is grounded, authorized, and accurate.

How you’ll make an impact:

•
Strategy & Portfolio: Partner with global product, engineering, and business leaders to prioritize high-value context initiatives, sequencing workflows based on business impact, agent demand, source readiness, and risk.

•
Governed Semantic Layer & NL-to-SQL: Own the semantic object roadmap for core enterprise entities (e.g., accounts, claims, plans), defining certified measures, join graphs, and Row-Level Security (RLS) to replace raw schema reasoning and eliminate hallucinations.

•
Retrieval & Grounding: Establish enterprise standards for federated ingestion, chunking, caching, metadata, and citation enforcement, consolidating legacy knowledge APIs into unified, multi-tenant interfaces.

•
Workflow Context Packs: Design and deliver production-ready context packs for critical operational workflows and SOPs, partnering directly with agent teams to inspect retrieval traces, debug failures, and optimize context consumption.

•
Quality & Benchmarks: Build and run rigorous evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, error taxonomies, and go/no-go quality gates to benchmark retrieval relevance, query precision, and agent containment.

•
Governance & Value Realization: Embed auditability, data lineage, least-privilege access, and responsible AI guardrails into the context layer by design, tracking ROI through API cost reduction, task resolution lift, and operational risk mitigation.

Experience you’ll bring:

•
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

•
Experience: Senior-level Product Management experience owning data platforms, enterprise search/retrieval systems, semantic layers, API products, or internal developer platforms consumed by engineering teams.

•
Technical Skills: Deep understanding of applied generative AI and agentic systems, including advanced RAG, embeddings, chunking, metadata management, grounding, and context window assembly.

•
Data Modeling & SQL: Strong experience working with structured enterprise data, relational models, certified metrics, and the failure modes of natural-language querying over raw database schemas.

•
Hands-on Technical Depth: Demonstrated comfort working directly with technical artifacts-inspecting retrieval traces, reading SQL query plans, reviewing JSON/YAML configurations, and executing API calls.

•
AI Evaluation & Benchmarking: Proven track record of designing and running evaluation harnesses, golden benchmark datasets, error taxonomies, and quantitative quality gates.

•
Security & Governance: Solid working knowledge of enterprise controls, including authentication/identity, tenant isolation, Row-Level Security (RLS), audit logging, and data privacy.

•
Communication & Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with a demonstrated ability to align and influence global engineering, security, compliance, and executive stakeholders without direct authority.

What will give you an edge:

• Experience with Knowledge Graphs, ontologies, taxonomies, and enterprise entity resolution (MDM).

• Hands-on familiarity with headless BI, metric stores (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, Cube), or governed NL-to-SQL products.

Your Impact

As an Axon CMM Metrology Programmer, you will perform dimensional and vision inspection and testing of incoming, in process, and finished product by using various measurement devices to ensure compliance with engineering specifications.

Location: Onsite at Axon’s Pinnacle Manufacturing Location in Mesa, AZ
Reports to: Supervisor, Incoming Quality Control
Direct Reports: N/A

• Program and Operate the Axon TACTILE CMM (Zeiss Contura/Calypso) to provide measurement analysis for incoming parts, in process and finished goods.

• Maintain PiWeb and QC gage DB, structure and dimensional plans for future analysis and studies. Perform GR&R according to scheduled plan. Conduct FAIR and PPAP dimensional reports to evaluate new or modified parts.

• Provide dimensional analysis for CAPA investigations to aid in root cause analysis.

• Read and interpret CAD models and prints.

• Generate OPTICAL/TACTILE CMM programs to make repeat inspections more efficient. Manage the CMM equipment, including maintenance, calibration, and readiness of equipment. Assist in sustaining Critical to Quality processes via training and providing accept/reject samples to manufacturing.

What You Bring

• 2-4 year degree in Technology/Engineering or equivalent experience.

• Minimum of 3 years Quality/Mfg experience.

• Strong aptitude in process improvement and problem solving.

•
Minimum of 5 years working level experience measuring and programing CMM Zeiss Contura, CMM Zeiss OIS-322, Calypso Software and Keyence LM series.

title: Executive Underwriter – Professional Liability (Architects & Engineers)
description:
Position Summary
The Executive Underwriter - Professional Liability is responsible for driving profitable growth through the underwriting and management of a portfolio of Architects & Engineers (A&E) Professional Liability risks, while supporting broader Errors & Omissions (E&O) initiatives. This role evaluates complex risks, develops tailored coverage solutions, and partners closely with retail brokers to expand business opportunities and strengthen key market relationships.

The Executive Underwriter serves as a senior technical resource within the team, balancing growth and profitability objectives while partnering with underwriting leadership on portfolio strategy, broker engagement, and market development.

Location: Remote What will your job entail?

Key Responsibilities:

Underwriting & Portfolio Management

• Independently underwrite and manage a portfolio of Professional Liability risks, with a primary focus on Architects & Engineers accounts.

• Evaluate small and middle market risks, including complex exposures, to ensure sound risk selection and profitable portfolio growth.

• Analyze submissions, financial information, loss history, and operational exposures to determine appropriate pricing, coverage structure, and terms.

• Underwrite both admitted and surplus lines business within delegated underwriting authority.

Broker & Market Development

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with retail brokers and distribution partners on a national basis.

• Identify and pursue new business opportunities within targeted markets and industry segments.

• Negotiate pricing, coverage, and policy terms while maintaining underwriting discipline and profitability objectives.

• Collaborate with brokers to develop solutions that meet client needs and support long-term business growth.

Strategy & Technical Expertise

• Support underwriting leadership in executing portfolio strategies and achieving business objectives.

• Monitor market conditions, industry trends, and competitive developments impacting Professional Liability business.

• Contribute technical expertise related to A&E Professional Liability and other E&O products, including Accountants Professional Liability exposures.

• Assist in the development and enhancement of underwriting guidelines, product offerings, and best practices.

Collaboration & Portfolio Performance

• Partner with Claims, Actuarial, Product, Legal, and Compliance teams to support underwriting decisions and portfolio management.

• Monitor portfolio performance, including premium growth, retention, profitability, and loss ratio trends.

• Maintain accurate underwriting documentation and ensure compliance with company guidelines and regulatory requirements.

• Provide mentorship and technical guidance to less experienced underwriting staff as needed.

Qualifications:

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Business Administration, Finance, Insurance, or a related field preferred.

• 10+ years of Professional Liability / E&O underwriting experience.

• Significant experience underwriting Architects & Engineers Professional Liability risks required.

• Exposure to other Professional Liability products preferred.

• Experience underwriting both admitted and surplus lines business.

• Demonstrated success evaluating small and middle market accounts, including complex risks, while balancing growth and profitability objectives.

• Established relationships with retail brokers within the Professional Liability marketplace strongly preferred.

Licenses & Certifications

• State Property & Casualty and/or Surplus Lines license required.

• CPCU, AU, RPLU, or other relevant insurance designations preferred.

Skills & Competencies

• Deep expertise in Professional Liability and Errors & Omissions underwriting.

• Strong understanding of Architects & Engineers risk exposures and coverage considerations.

• Advanced risk assessment, pricing, and coverage analysis capabilities.

Build durable operating muscle

Drive AI Transformation in Engineering and Cloud Operations

title: Unreal Engine Cinematic Artist (Previz & Camera Work)
description:
About the Role

Atrium is a YouTube channel focused on bringing history to life through immersive visual storytelling, from exploring Hitler’s final hours to recreating the conditions of Auschwitz.

We’re looking for a full-time 3D Layout Artist to help shape the visual direction of our content through cinematic scene composition, camera operation, and storytelling.

This is a highly creative role for someone who thinks visually and understands how camera work can transform a script into an engaging viewing experience. You’ll work closely with the Channel Director to translate scripts into compelling 3D layouts and animatics, defining camera movement, scene composition, pacing, and the overall visual tone of each video.

Your work will serve as the blueprint for the animation team, ensuring every scene is thoughtfully composed, visually clear, and intentional before moving into full production.

What You’ll Be Obsessed About

Making every scene work visually.

You understand that great storytelling isn't just about what happens on screen, but how the audience experiences it. You think about camera angles, movement, composition, pacing, character posing, and transitions, always looking for ways to make each moment clearer, more cinematic, and more engaging.

You’re always thinking:

“How can I make this scene more compelling through composition, camera work, and staging?”

And then you make it happen.

What You’ll Do

• Interpret scripts and translate them into clear, compelling 3D layouts and animatics.

• Operate virtual cameras to establish framing, camera movement, shot composition, and transitions.

• Define the visual flow of each scene, including timing, pacing, spatial relationships, and continuity.

• Handle animation blocking and character posing to establish clear actions, staging, and storytelling beats.

• Collaborate closely with the Channel Director to develop and refine the visual storytelling approach.

• Build scenes and layouts in Unreal Engine, preparing environments and assets for review and production.

• Explore creative camera techniques and visual solutions to communicate complex historical events, environments, and concepts.

• Prepare clear, well-organized layouts and animatics that give animators a strong foundation for production.

• Prepare and organize scenes, assets, and project files within a hands-on production pipeline that requires careful manual setup and coordination.

• Review outputs, incorporate feedback, and refine layouts to meet the creative vision.

• Maintain consistency and continuity across scenes while keeping project files and assets accessible to the team.

About You

• Several years of experience in 3D layout, animation, camera work, or a related role in YouTube, film, or television production.

• Strong proficiency in Unreal Engine, ideally version 5.6.1.

• Strong understanding of cinematic language, including composition, framing, camera movement, timing, and transitions.

• Experience with animation blocking and character posing, with an understanding of how staging and body language support storytelling.

• A good eye for visual storytelling and the ability to translate scripts into clear, engaging sequences.

• Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage assets, scenes, and project files independently in a hands-on production environment.

• Proactive, collaborative, and able to communicate clearly in a fast-moving production environment.

• Comfortable working independently, solving visual challenges, and incorporating feedback without losing sight of the overall creative vision.

Nice to Have

• Working knowledge of Blender for 3D scene preparation or related tasks.

• Experience managing or contributing to 3D animation pipelines.

• Understanding of YouTube retention, pacing, and viewer engagement.

• Interest in storytelling psychology and audience behavior.

• Experience working on documentaries, historical content, or educational entertainment.

description:
Technical QA Engineer
Location: Remote (Pakistan)
Job Type: Full-time
Work Schedule: 9:00 AM-5:00 PM Pacific Time

Role Overview
We're looking for a Technical QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and security of our software products! As we increasingly use AI and development agents to build and improve software, we need someone who can independently validate what those systems produce - both from a user perspective and at a technical level.
In this role, you'll test applications, APIs, databases, integrations, and new features; review and understand code well enough to identify potential quality, logic, and security issues; build and maintain automated tests; and investigate technical problems using logs, debugging tools, and application data.
We're in need of someone who's technically strong to understand how a system works, challenge assumptions, investigate failures, and independently determine whether software is behaving correctly.
Key Responsibilities

• Test new features, improvements, integrations, and bug fixes across our software products.

• Perform functional, regression, integration, API, database, exploratory, and edge-case testing.

• Review and understand application code well enough to design better tests, identify likely failure points, investigate issues more deeply, and validate software behavior independently.

• Build, maintain, and improve automated tests for critical functionality and regression coverage.

• Use AI coding agents and AI-assisted tools to help create tests, expand test coverage, investigate failures, analyze logs, and improve QA efficiency.

• Critically validate AI-generated software and tests rather than assuming generated output is correct.

• Test APIs directly, including requests, responses, authentication, error handling, data validation, and unexpected inputs.

• Validate application data and database behavior using SQL or similar tools.

• Test integrations between internal and external systems and identify failure scenarios.

• Investigate issues using logs, stack traces, browser developer tools, API responses, database queries, and other debugging information.

• Help identify the root cause of defects rather than only reporting visible symptoms.

• Reproduce and isolate software issues and provide developers with clear technical findings.

• Create detailed bug reports with reproduction steps, expected vs. actual behavior, environment details, and supporting evidence.

• Verify fixes and perform regression testing before issues are closed or released.

• Work closely with developers to improve testability, reliability, and overall product quality.

• Continuously improve QA processes, test coverage, and automation.

Requirements

• Atleast 2 years of experience as a Technical QA Engineer, QA Automation Engineer, Software Engineer, Software Developer, or another technical software testing role.

• Programming or scripting experience with Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, or another relevant language.

• Experience using logs, debugging tools, API responses, database queries, and other technical evidence to investigate failures.

• Experience with automated testing tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, pytest, or similar.

• Strong understanding of web applications, APIs, HTTP, authentication, and browser technologies.

• Hands-on experience testing APIs using Postman, curl, or similar tools.

• Experience working with SQL and relational or NoSQL databases.

• Comfortable using Git / GitHub or similar version control systems.

• Comfortable using browser developer tools, logs, stack traces, and other debugging information to investigate problems.

• Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to investigate issues beyond their visible symptoms.

• Strong understanding of testing methodologies, regression testing, edge cases, and failure scenarios.

• Ability to write clear, actionable bug reports with releva

title: Systems Engineer - Aerospace
description:
Why Genova?

If you're looking for the stability and benefits of a large company in a small company atmosphere, Genova is the place for you.

If you're looking to work in a community filled with nice people, Genova is the place for you.

If you're looking for a place that you'll want to stay with until you retire, Genova is the place for you.

Come and enjoy your workday at Genova Technologies ! Join our team!

Genova Technologies has an immediate opening for a Systems Engineer in Cedar Rapids, IA.

What will you do?

The person in this role will support systems engineering activities for an ongoing Navigation and Positioning project. You will work alongside the software engineering team to migrate an existing tool to a new RTOS (LynxOS) platform, while adding additional features and adhering to DO-278 guidelines. This position can be completed remotely, or work can be performed at our Cedar Rapids, IA office.

This role will:

• Lead and support systems engineering activities across the full program lifecycle, from requirements definition through verification and validation

• Develop, review, and manage system requirements, interface control documents (ICDs), and system architecture

• Apply DO-278A processes to ensure safety and integrity assurance for ground-based CNS/ATM systems, in support of certification compliance

• Collaborate with software, hardware, and test engineers to ensure system integrity and traceability

• Conduct system-level trade studies, risk assessments, and failure mode analyses (FMEA/FHA)

• Support customer interactions, technical reviews, and program milestone events

• Develop and review test plans, test procedures, and verification reports.

What do you need?

The ideal candidate for this position will have:

• 4-year degree in Science, Technology, or a similar field

• Minimum 4 years of experience in Systems Engineering within Aerospace, Defense, or Avionics

• Hands-on experience with DO-178C (Software Considerations in Airborne Systems) and/or DO-278A (Software Integrity Assurance Considerations for CNS/ATM Systems)

• Strong understanding of requirements management tools (e.g., DOORS or Jama)

• Experience with system-level V&V processes.

Skills we consider a plus include:

• Experience in Navigation, Positioning, and/or Communications (Nav/Pos/Comms) systems

• Knowledge of FAA certification processes and regulatory documentation (TSO, STC, AC).

What do you get?

Genova provides a competitive benefits package that includes:

· Medical, dental, vision coverage

· Life and disability insurance

· Paid holidays and scaling PTO

· A generous 401k plan

· And more!

title: Commercial & Operations Manager, Life Sciences Partnerships
description:
About Lighten

Lighten envisions a future where clinical data drives the next generation of breakthroughs in human health, from uncovering personalized treatment insights, to accelerating drug discovery, to driving adoption of innovative therapies.
We build AI-native software platforms that transform raw clinical data into the highest-quality patient journeys, accelerating evidence generation for R&D and bringing life-saving therapies to market faster. We partner with life sciences and healthcare organizations to help them deliver on their mission for the patients they serve.
We offer competitive salary and employee equity options, 3% company-sponsored 401k contributions, and comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance for employees and their families.
About the role
This is a unique role at the intersection of our executive team, commercial team, and clinical team. You’ll sit at the center of how Lighten wins and delivers: helping close deals on the commercial side while making sure what we sell is accurately translated into what our clinical team builds. It’s a front-row seat to how a high-growth life sciences AI company operates, with a clear path into a sales role or a Chief of Staff role as you grow.
What you’ll do

• Partner with leadership. Work directly with the executive team and commercial team on pipeline, priorities, and cross-functional initiatives.

• Join the conversation. Participate in customer calls with pharma and life sciences clients, capturing needs, following up, and helping move opportunities forward.

• Draft proposals. Write and assemble proposals, scopes of work, and RFP responses that clearly communicate Lighten ’s approach, deliverables, and value.

• Keep deals on track. Maintain accurate tracking of opportunity status, next steps, and deadlines across the pipeline, and flag risks early.

• Translate client needs. Work with our clinical team to turn client requirements (cohort definitions, endpoints, data needs) into clear, actionable specifications, and relay clinical feedback back to the commercial team and client.

• Build the operating system. Improve our templates, processes, and internal playbooks so the commercial team can move faster and more consistently.

What we’re looking for

• 3-5 years of experience in a client-facing, operations, consulting, or analytical role, ideally in life sciences, healthcare, or health data/technology.

• Excellent written communication, with the ability to turn complex technical or clinical material into clear, persuasive proposals.

• Exceptional organization and follow-through, comfortable managing many moving pieces and deadlines at once.

• Comfort working with senior stakeholders, both internal executives and external clients.

• Curiosity and the ability to quickly learn clinical and data concepts well enough to bridge commercial and clinical teams.

• A self-starter mindset: you thrive in a fast-moving startup, take ownership, and figure things out without waiting to be told.

Nice to have

• Background in epidemiology, biostatistics, public health, other scientific fields, clinical/medical training or consulting

• Working knowledge of EHR and claims data

• Exposure to life sciences commercial, RWE, HEOR, or medical affairs organizations

• Experience with CRM tools and proposal or RFP processes

description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SR. BRAND DESIGNER

We are looking for a Senior Brand Designer to help shape how SpaceXSI shows up in the world. This role is built for someone who has built brand systems in fast-moving environments, cares deeply about craft, and brings an AI-first mindset to how creative work gets made. You'll join the Brand Studio, the team behind the brand across the entire SpaceXSI ecosystem (from Grok and Grok Bot to X), and help shape both the brand system itself and how it comes to life in our campaigns. This is a hands-on role.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Brand system: Evolve and extend the visual identity (logo, typography, color, layout, imagery, and graphic language) and document it so other teams can apply it correctly

- Workflows & toolkits: Turn recurring design work into repeatable, AI-assisted workflows: templates, tools, and generators that let marketing, product, and other teams produce on-brand work without you in the room

- Campaigns: Concept and design campaigns end to end, from first idea through final production, across key visuals, launch assets, web, social, paid, out-of-home, and print

- Creative direction: Direct agencies and freelancers with clear briefs and candid feedback so the output meets the bar you'd set yourself

- Collaboration: Partner with marketing, product, engineering, and leadership; bring a brand point of view to new surfaces as they appear, and present your thinking clearly to senior stakeholders

- Range at speed: Move between projects quickly while holding a consistently high bar, and keep improving the process, not just the output

- minimum of 4 years of brand design experience, in-house or at an agency or studio

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Fluency in AI coding tools, especially Cursor. You can build your own tools, scripts, prototypes, and simple web pages instead of waiting on engineering

- A portfolio that shows both brand system work and shipped campaigns. Bonus if it includes tools or workflows you built

- Sharp typography, layout, and art direction instincts

- A systems mindset: you naturally turn one-off tasks into reusable processes and think about how creative work scales

- Conviction in your design decisions and the ability to explain why they matter, to designers, marketers, and leadership alike

- Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud

- Self-directed, fast, and energized by variety and ambiguity

- Experience building or relaunching a brand identity at a fast-growing tech company

- Motion sensibility, enough to design with motion in mind and direct motion designers

- Experience leading agencies on large, multi-channel campaigns

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the San Francisco or New York office

$172,000 - $250,000 USD

title: AI research scientist
description:
🚀 ABOUT WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance.

 

Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com.

 
 

📐 ABOUT THE ROLE

AI research at WRITER isn't just about publishing papers; it's about building the scientific foundation that powers some of the most ambitious enterprise AI deployments in the world. As an AI research scientist, you'll be at the center of that work. You'll drive a high-impact research agenda focused on large language models, agentic reasoning, and the system-level capabilities that make AI genuinely useful at enterprise scale. This is a rare opportunity to do research that matters twice over: advancing the field and shipping directly into products used by hundreds of thousands of people every day.

We're at an inflection point. Enterprises are moving from experimenting with AI to deeply embedding it across their operations, and WRITER's models are the engine making that possible. The work you do here-on post-training, planning, multi-step reasoning, and agentic workflows-will directly shape how the next generation of enterprise AI behaves, performs, and scales. You'll have the resources, infrastructure, and cross-functional support to pursue ambitious ideas and bring them to life quickly.

This role is hybrid, based out of our San Francisco or New York City hub. You’ll report to our VP of AI research.

Please note: role is open to Senior applicants
We are open to hiring for this role at multiple levels, with compensation ranges scaled to match your experience, expertise, and the scope of the role.

 
 
 

🦸🏻‍♀️ WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Work on a high-impact research agenda on large language models and agentic systems, being a core member of a team working on projects involving data synthesis, novel model architectures, model training, evaluation, and production deployment

- Help design and execute post-training experiments using supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), RLAIF, DPO, etc., and emerging alignment techniques, with a focus on improving multi-step reasoning, planning, and tool use in enterprise agentic workflows

- Build novel evaluation benchmarks and methodologies that push beyond existing limitations, establishing rigorous measures for how well models perform on complex, real-world enterprise tasks

- Develop scalable data synthesis and curation pipelines that generate the high-quality training signal driving model improvement, including LLM-as-judge frameworks, synthetic data generation, and adversarial dataset construction

- Shape WRITER's model architecture and training roadmap by translating your research insights into concrete improvements to our enterprise-grade LLMs, working hand-in-hand with research engineering and product teams

- Publish and present original research at top-tier venues-NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, and others-representing WRITER at the frontier of the field and contributing to the broader scientific community

- Work closely with fellow researchers and engineers on the team, helping set a high bar for scientific rigor, experimental design, and research culture

title: Senior Program Manager, Maximum Impact Incubator
description:
Overview
The Clinton Health Access Initiative , Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems.
CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally.
At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work:
CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. CHAI values diversity and inclusion, and recognizes that our mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people with diverse experience, backgrounds, and culture.
Position Overview
The Maximum Impact Incubator (MII) aims to utilize econometrics and epidemiology to incubate programs across CHAI's entire portfolio that generate significant health impact through highly cost-effective programming. The Maximum Impact Incubator team has the exciting and challenging aim of working with CHAI’s country and program teams to develop the most cost-effective and scalable opportunities for new programs aligned with the Effective Altruism (EA) philosophy of maximizing the benefit of available resources.
As a Senior Program Manager on the MII team, you will play a key role in ensuring the programs graduated from the incubator run smoothly and deliver on agreed implementation, research, and learning objectives, including supporting program launch, implementation, coordination, and donor management. After the MII team completes its investigation of new programs, which includes assessing a program’s cost-effectiveness, potential research objectives and learning objectives, and programs receive grant funding from EA-aligned donors, these programs “graduate” from the incubator. During the implementation phase, graduated grants are owned and implemented by the relevant CHAI program and country team (e.g., a program delivering Zinc/ORS to treat childhood diarrhoea in Nigeria would be owned by CHAI’s Child Health and Nigeria teams during implementation); the incubator’s role is to manage the donor relationship and to serve as the institutional memory of the original vision that was agreed between the donor, MII and the program and country teams during the MII-led investigation.
